facts_of_case: The petitioner/wife has been residing separately in her parents' house due to matrimonial disputes. She filed a Maintenance Case under Section 125 of Cr.P.C and the respondent/husband filed a petition seeking to declare the marriage as null and void.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer petition can be filed to avoid inconvenience.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner and for the reasons mentioned in the accompanying affidavit, there shall be an order of Interim Stay of all further proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: A party may file a transfer petition to avoid inconvenience in attending court proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The averments mentioned in the affidavit of the petitioner/wife prima facie further go to show that the distance between Rajahmundry and Visakhapatnam is more than 200Kms and it is difficult for the petitioner/wife to travel to attend the divorce case proceedings which was filed by the respondent/husband herein before the Court at Visakhapatnam on each and every adjournment without any male assistance.

outcome.final_order: Interim Stay of all further proceedings including appearance of the petitioner herein i.e., respondent in F.C.O.P.No.1080 of 2023 on the file of the Famiy Judge-cum-V Additional District Court, Visakhapatnam, till 22.01.2026.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on maintenance rights under Section 125 CrPC
assisting with matrimonial disputes and separate residence
